summary: 补录2026-10-11遗漏维护部分：Splat2Act/LAPT-Scale/Dual-Stream Memory三篇一手深读；RoboTwin和RoboMME 2份原表10条结果；ROSCon/NVIDIA/AWS官方新闻三条。检索仍partial，前一个complete搜索checkpoint保持10月4日。

tracks.name: LAPT-Scale v1 · RoboTwin 2.0 Easy / Hard
tracks.protocol: Official 50-task RoboTwin 2.0 Easy standard and Hard varied randomized layout; 50 clean and 500 randomized demos/task are training, not eval settings. Results by reporting paper.
tracks.trainingRegime: LAPT 5.1K human videos + 250 hours alignment + robot task posttraining; cited baseline models have different pretraining architectures and data budgets.

tracks.name: Dual-Stream Memory v1 · RoboMME 16 tasks
tracks.protocol: 16 tasks, 50 test episodes per task and seed, 3 evaluation seeds 0/7/42; reported task-equal overall mean. FrameSamp baseline differs by checkpoint aggregation.
tracks.trainingRegime: Policy trained 80K steps with frozen temporal compressor, retrieved spatial tokens; reported baseline checkpoint aggregation may differ.
